name: POS Complimentary Product
description: This module enhances Point of Sale by enabling automatic addition of complimentary products to orders. It simplifies promotional offers by linking free items with selected products, reducing manual effort at checkout.
summary: The POS Complimentary Products module enhances Odoo’s Point of Sale by automating promotional offers with complimentary (free) items. Instead of relying on cashiers to manually add free products during checkout, the app automatically applies them whenever the defined rules are met. With flexible configuration options, businesses can enable the feature in POS settings and assign complimentary products directly from the product form. Quantity thresholds and offer limits provide greater control, making promotions like “Buy 5, Get 1 Free” simple to manage. Complimentary products are clearly displayed in POS order lines and on printed receipts, ensuring full visibility and transparency for customers. This automation not only improves the customer experience but also saves cashier time, reduces errors, and guarantees consistent application of promotional campaigns. The module is ideal for retailers, supermarkets, and restaurants looking to run Odoo POS promotions such as free products, loyalty offers, or buy-one-get-one deals. By automating promotional items in POS, businesses can boost sales, strengthen customer loyalty, and simplify their marketing efforts. name: POS Cancel Order History
description: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale with the ability to cancel orders by providing a reason. Keep a detailed history of all canceled orders for better tracking, accountability, and manager control.
summary: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale with a smart cancellation workflow. This module allows cashiers to cancel orders only by providing a valid reason, ensuring every cancellation is properly documented. A dedicated history menu gives managers full visibility into canceled orders, including details such as who canceled, when, and why. With this added control, businesses can improve accountability, reduce errors, and maintain a transparent POS environment. The POS Cancel Order History module for Odoo 18 solves this problem by introducing a smart and transparent workflow for order cancellations in the Point of Sale system. Whenever a cashier cancels an order, the system prompts them to enter a cancellation reason through a popup window. This ensures that every cancellation is properly documented. A dedicated Cancel Order History menu allows managers and administrators to view all canceled orders in one place. From this menu, you can quickly access details such as the order reference, the responsible user, the cancellation reason, and the exact date and time of cancellation. The EG POS Amount to Word module for Odoo is designed to enhance the point of sale (POS) experience by displaying amounts in both numeric and textual formats on customer receipts. This feature provides improved clarity and transparency, making invoices and receipts more user-friendly for both customers and internal users. It caters to businesses that want to improve customer satisfaction by ensuring that amounts are displayed in a dual format, helping avoid misunderstandings. By using this module, businesses can offer dual-format billing, where the total amount due is shown in both digits and words, which is particularly useful in regions where legal or formal documents require amounts to be written in words for verification purposes. This readable invoicing system promotes clearer communication and makes the receipt much easier to understand, particularly for customers who may not be familiar with complex numeric figures.
